10588.problem: Write a while loop implementing the Metropolis-Hastings sampler for a Gaussian target. Print acceptance rate.
10588.answer:
local x_mh = 0
local accepted = 0
local total_mh = 10000
local proposal_std = 1.0

for (i: 1 .. total_mh) {
  local x_prop = x_mh + (randFloat() * 2 - 1) * proposal_std
  local log_alpha = -0.5 * x_prop * x_prop - (-0.5 * x_mh * x_mh)
  local u = randFloat()
  if (log(u) < log_alpha) {
    x_mh = x_prop
    accepted = accepted + 1
  }
}
println("Acceptance rate: " _ (accepted / total_mh))

10620.problem: Write a while loop implementing BFGS quasi-Newton optimisation on the Rosenbrock function.
10620.answer:
local x_bfgs = [0, 0]
local lr_bfgs = 0.001
local iters_bfgs = 10000

func rosenbrock(x) = {
  (1 - x[1]) ^ 2 + 100 * (x[2] - x[1] ^ 2) ^ 2
}

func rosenGrad(x) = {
  local g1 = -2 * (1 - x[1]) - 400 * x[1] * (x[2] - x[1]^2)
  local g2 = 200 * (x[2] - x[1]^2)
  [g1, g2]
}

local H_inv = [[1, 0], [0, 1]]
local iter_b = 0

while (iter_b < iters_bfgs) {
  local g = rosenGrad(x_bfgs)
  local p = [-(H_inv[1][1]*g[1] + H_inv[1][2]*g[2]),
             -(H_inv[2][1]*g[1] + H_inv[2][2]*g[2])]
  local alpha = lr_bfgs
  local x_new = [x_bfgs[1] + alpha*p[1], x_bfgs[2] + alpha*p[2]]
  local g_new = rosenGrad(x_new)
  local s = [x_new[1]-x_bfgs[1], x_new[2]-x_bfgs[2]]
  local y = [g_new[1]-g[1], g_new[2]-g[2]]
  local sy = s[1]*y[1] + s[2]*y[2]
  if (abs(sy) > 1e-10) {
    local rho = 1 / sy
    local Hy = [H_inv[1][1]*y[1]+H_inv[1][2]*y[2], H_inv[2][1]*y[1]+H_inv[2][2]*y[2]]
    local yHy = y[1]*Hy[1] + y[2]*Hy[2]
    H_inv[1][1] = H_inv[1][1] - rho*(s[1]*Hy[1]+Hy[1]*s[1]) + rho*(rho*yHy+1)*s[1]*s[1]
    H_inv[1][2] = H_inv[1][2] - rho*(s[1]*Hy[2]+Hy[1]*s[2]) + rho*(rho*yHy+1)*s[1]*s[2]
    H_inv[2][1] = H_inv[2][1] - rho*(s[2]*Hy[1]+Hy[2]*s[1]) + rho*(rho*yHy+1)*s[2]*s[1]
    H_inv[2][2] = H_inv[2][2] - rho*(s[2]*Hy[2]+Hy[2]*s[2]) + rho*(rho*yHy+1)*s[2]*s[2]
  }
  x_bfgs = x_new
  iter_b = iter_b + 1
}
println("BFGS result: " _ x_bfgs _ " f=" _ rosenbrock(x_bfgs))

10267.problem: Write `muller(f_name, x0, x1, x2, maxIter)` — Müller's method for root-finding. Test.
10267.answer:
func muller(f_name, x0, x1, x2, maxIter) = {
  local p0 = x0
  local p1 = x1
  local p2 = x2
  local root_m = p2
  local iter_m = 0
  while (iter_m < maxIter) {
    local f0 = p0^3 - p0 - 2
    local f1 = p1^3 - p1 - 2
    local f2 = p2^3 - p2 - 2
    local h1 = p1 - p0
    local h2 = p2 - p1
    local d1 = (f1 - f0) / h1
    local d2 = (f2 - f1) / h2
    local a_m = (d2 - d1) / (h2 + h1)
    local b_m = a_m * h2 + d2
    local c_m = f2
    local disc = b_m^2 - 4*a_m*c_m
    local denom = if (abs(b_m + sqrt(abs(disc))) > abs(b_m - sqrt(abs(disc)))) b_m + sqrt(abs(disc)) else b_m - sqrt(abs(disc))
    if (abs(denom) < 1e-15) {
      iter_m = maxIter
    }
    local dx = -2 * c_m / denom
    root_m = p2 + dx
    p0 = p1
    p1 = p2
    p2 = root_m
    iter_m = iter_m + 1
    if (abs(dx) < 1e-8) {
      iter_m = maxIter
    }
  }
  root_m
}

println("Muller root: " _ muller("cubic", 0, 1, 2, 50))

func correlationCoeff(x, y) = {
  local n = x.listLen()
  local mx = x.reduce(0) { v, s -> v + s } / n
  local my = y.reduce(0) { v, s -> v + s } / n
  local num = 0
  local dx2 = 0
  local dy2 = 0
  for (i: 1 .. n) {
    num = num + (x[i] - mx) * (y[i] - my)
    dx2 = dx2 + (x[i] - mx)^2
    dy2 = dy2 + (y[i] - my)^2
  }
  num / sqrt(dx2 * dy2)
}

10463.answer:
func tTest_2sample(a, b) = {
  local na = a.listLen()
  local nb = b.listLen()
  local ma = a.reduce(0) { x, s -> x + s } / na
  local mb = b.reduce(0) { x, s -> x + s } / nb
  local va = a.map { x -> (x-ma)^2 }.reduce(0) { x, s -> x + s } / (na - 1)
  local vb = b.map { x -> (x-mb)^2 }.reduce(0) { x, s -> x + s } / (nb - 1)
  local se = sqrt(va/na + vb/nb)
  local t_stat = (ma - mb) / se
  local df = na + nb - 2
  {"t": t_stat, "df": df, "mean_a": ma, "mean_b": mb}
}

10656.answer:
func bayesianInference(prior, likelihood, data) = {
  local mu0 = prior.get("mean")
  local sig0 = prior.get("std")
  local sig_l = likelihood.get("std")
  local n = data.listLen()
  local data_mean = data.reduce(0) { x, s -> x + s } / n
  local post_var = 1 / (1/sig0^2 + n/sig_l^2)
  local post_mean = post_var * (mu0/sig0^2 + n*data_mean/sig_l^2)
  {"mean": post_mean, "std": sqrt(post_var)}
}

10594.problem: Write a for-each loop over a list of signal samples computing running statistics (mean, variance, max). Print.
10594.answer:
local samples = [3.1, 2.7, 4.5, 1.9, 5.2, 3.8, 4.1, 2.3, 6.0, 3.5]
local run_count = 0
local run_mean = 0
local run_m2 = 0
local run_max = samples[1]

for (x in samples) {
  run_count = run_count + 1
  local delta = x - run_mean
  run_mean = run_mean + delta / run_count
  local delta2 = x - run_mean
  run_m2 = run_m2 + delta * delta2
  if (x > run_max) {
    run_max = x
  }
  local run_var = if (run_count > 1) run_m2 / (run_count - 1) else 0
  println("n=" _ run_count _ " mean=" _ formatDecimal(run_mean, 4) _ " var=" _ formatDecimal(run_var, 4) _ " max=" _ run_max)
}
